A '''hypermatter research station''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boranall]]. The threat of the station falling into the hands of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was used by [[Minister of Logistics]] [[Davidge]] to persuade [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Karrid]] to travel to the [[Boranall system/Legends|Boranall system]] to [[Battle of Boranall|put down]] a rebellion in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
